_doc: W2-B-DECLARE item 2 — THE CORPUS'S SHARE of the page measure by vocabulary, handed to W2-WRITE (which alone edits docs/content/RECEIPT_POOLS_DOSSIER_STATE.md and runs its generator).

Each row: a corpus variant (block::pool, vid) that names a registered word (src/domain/facts/registeredWords.js) and carries no declaration that answers it. `disqualifier` lists the atoms any one of which, declared on the variant (its tag slot) or on the pool (its brace group), answers the word; a word ending in ":" is any band of that dimension.

kind "printed false on the 720": the census's 720 owner-view dossiers printed it in a town the word is false for (towns = how many). kind "unreached": a pool no rendered page of the 720 asked for; the measure is static.
Measured at the lane base 1930cec6e (+ the walker change e0f2bd58e, tests only). Scripts: docs/chair/2026-11-12/probes/W2-B-DECLARE/.

rows.text: Full stores help {settlement}'s fortunes. With food to spare and a granary to keep it in, the town has more to trade and less to fear from a bad year.

rows.text: Nobody at {settlement} worries much about the next meal, and the spare food in the granary is part of why the town does as well as it does.

rows.text: The stores will carry the town through hunger. Nothing here will carry it through a plague, and the town has not built anything that would.

rows.text: The occupiers are quartered inside the town, and the town's business is conducted around them.

rows.text: {settlement} is at war, and the war has reached the town as absence: the men, the carts, and the ordinary expectation of next year.

rows.text: Holding this place costs more than it returns. Garrisons, administrators and suppression tie down strength that was meant for elsewhere.
